name: Struck Bell
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' BELL: eleven fixed inharmonic partials, additively synthesised and struck once per trigger, sharing one decay curve and one odd/even detune. A fixed hand-tuned voicing, not a stretched-harmonic formula.

controls.label: Detune
controls.description: Spreads alternate partials apart around the module's own fixed ratios: every other one up, the rest down.

controls.label: Decay
controls.description: Blends the module's two decay tables, short at 0 to long near the top; past about 98% the bell drones forever.

controls.label: Brightness
controls.description: Tilts each partial's strike amplitude by position: soft mallet toward 0, the module's amplitudes at noon, hard toward 1.

controls.label: Decay spread
controls.description: Sets how much faster high partials decay than low: uniform toward 0, the module's spread at noon, exaggerated toward 1.

outputs.main: The eleven-partial sum. Tracks the module's own output closely; tests/ab.json carries the measured figures.
outputs.aux: Mono: the five highest partials alone, a bright fast-decaying companion voice. Stereo: a second, independently detuned eleven-partial render sharing the same amplitude envelope, for a wide chorused bell.
